cues: The enthalpy of reaction, for the amounts in the balanced equation.
The enthalpy of formation, for one mole of a compound made from its elements.
Combustion, for one mole burnt completely in oxygen.
Solution, for one mole dissolved in a large excess of solvent.
Neutralisation, for one equivalent of acid.
And remember, the formation enthalpy of any element in its standard state is zero.
